component.name: Redunar
component.summary: Capture recent gameplay and view in-game metrics

description.p: Redunar is a Linux app for Steam gameplay, with instant replays and in-game metrics on compatible graphics hardware.
It keeps game profiles, measurements, and recorded media on the user's machine. It does not require an online account or upload telemetry.

ul.li: Keep the Diagnostics panel steady when it opens or closes.
Keep the last Diagnostics results when a refresh fails. Clear the error when new results arrive.
Fix the line that flickered below notifications.
Ignore invalid readings in live system metrics and in History.
Clear unfinished updates to saved replay game labels at startup. Keep the previous labels and recordings.
Adjust the distance from the selected corner and apply it during a game by saving.
Show defaults on the Edge spacing, Scale, and Opacity sliders.
Move FPS only to Layout and open saved Grid layouts in Telemetry.
Redesigned the desktop app and combined clip playback and trimming.
Improved tray icon support on desktops that use lowercase icon names.
Moved routine capture counts to Diagnostics.
Reduced idle work by loading saved sessions on demand and pausing hidden UI updates.
Improved Replay recovery during tested storage stalls with bounded repair and queued-packet recovery.
Retired obsolete fixed frame-rate options while preserving migration of saved legacy values and resolution-aware Variable FPS.
Reduced repeated capability-discovery work through shared caching and serialized refresh.
Retired obsolete settings and compatibility surfaces while keeping older saved preferences readable during migration.
Initial Redunar release with support for compatible AMD/RADV and NVIDIA graphics.
Hardware Instant Replay through Vulkan Video, in-game metrics, profiles and clip playback/export.
Existing settings, history and recordings remain compatible.
